exposure.needed: whether the environment uses log matching/parsing on cert-manager log output

consequence.statement: Log message parsing or string matching patterns that depend on the previous unstructured log format will no longer work with structured logs, potentially breaking log aggregation, alerting, or monitoring integrations.
consequence.remediation: Update log parsing rules, regex patterns, and monitoring configurations that depend on specific log message strings to work with the new structured log format.

assertion.statement: Unstructured log messages in cert-manager have been replaced with structured logs, which breaks log string matching patterns.
